decade_prayer_sequence.rubric: Pray once on the large bead before the decade:
Pray ten times on the ten small beads of the decade while contemplating the Mystery:
After the tenth Hail Mary, pray:
Conclude the decade with the Fatima Prayer:

mystery_sets.title: The Joyful Mysteries
mystery_sets.liturgical_note: Traditionally prayed on Mondays, Saturdays, and Sundays of Advent and Christmas.
mystery_sets.theme_summary: Contemplating the Incarnation and hidden life of Christ through the joyful fiat of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

decades.title: The Annunciation
decades.scripture_text: And upon entering, the Angel said to her: "Hail, full of grace. The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women."... Then Mary said: "Behold, I am the handmaid of the Lord. Let it be done to me according to your word."
decades.meditation: With humble surrender, the Blessed Virgin welcomes the Archangel Gabriel's message and conceives the Eternal Word by the power of the Holy Spirit.

decades.title: The Visitation
decades.scripture_text: And it happened that, as Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, the infant leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit. And she cried out with a loud voice and said: "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb."... And Mary said: "My soul magnifies the Lord. And my spirit leaps for joy in God my Savior."
decades.meditation: Bearing Christ within her, Mary hastens in charity to visit and care for her aged cousin Elizabeth, bringing sanctifying joy to the unborn John the Baptist.

artwork.title: The Visitation
artwork.current_location: Princeton University Art Museum, Princeton, New Jersey

decades.title: The Nativity of Our Lord
decades.scripture_text: Then it happened that, while they were there, the days were completed, so that she would give birth. And she brought forth her firstborn son. And she wrapped him in swaddling clothes and laid him in a manger, because there was no room for them at the inn... And the Angel said to them: "Do not be afraid. For, behold, I proclaim to you a great joy, which will be for all the people. For today a Savior has been born for you in the city of David: he is Christ the Lord."
decades.meditation: In the stillness of Bethlehem's night, the Light of the World is born in humble poverty, adored by Mary, Joseph, the angels, and the simple shepherds.

decades.title: The Presentation of Jesus in the Temple
decades.scripture_text: And after the days of her purification were fulfilled, according to the law of Moses, they brought him to Jerusalem, in order to present him to the Lord... [Then Simeon] took him up, into his arms, and he blessed God and said: "Now you may dismiss your servant in peace, O Lord, according to your word. For my eyes have seen your salvation, which you have prepared before the face of all peoples: the light of revelation to the nations and the glory of your people Israel."
decades.meditation: In loving obedience to the Law of the Lord, Mary and Joseph offer the Infant Jesus in the Temple, where righteous Simeon recognizes the promised Redeemer.

artwork.title: Presentation of Jesus in the Temple

decades.title: The Finding of Jesus in the Temple
decades.scripture_text: And it happened that, after three days, they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, listening to them and questioning them. And all who listened to him were astonished over his prudence and his responses... And he said to them: "How is it that you were seeking me? For did you not know that it is necessary for me to be in these things which are of my Father?"... And his mother kept all these words in her heart.
decades.meditation: After three days of sorrowful searching, Mary and Joseph rejoice to find the twelve-year-old Jesus in His Father's house, illuminating the teachers of Israel with divine wisdom.

artwork.title: Christ among the Doctors
artwork.current_location: National Gallery of Art, Washington, D.C.

mystery_sets.title: The Luminous Mysteries
mystery_sets.liturgical_note: Traditionally prayed on Thursdays (The Mysteries of Light, introduced by Pope St. John Paul II in 2002).
mystery_sets.theme_summary: Contemplating the public ministry of Christ as the Light of the World, from the Jordan to the Upper Room.

decades.title: The Baptism of Jesus in the Jordan
decades.scripture_text: And Jesus, having been baptized, ascended from the water immediately, and behold, the heavens were opened to him. And he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and alighting on him. And behold, there was a voice from heaven, saying: "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."
decades.meditation: Descending into the River Jordan to sanctify the waters of Baptism, Christ is anointed by the Holy Spirit and proclaimed the Beloved Son of the Eternal Father.

decades.title: The Wedding Feast at Cana
decades.scripture_text: And when the wine was failing, the mother of Jesus said to him, "They have no wine." And Jesus said to her: "What is that to me and to you, woman? My hour has not yet arrived." His mother said to the servants, "Do whatever he tells you."... This was the beginning of the signs that Jesus accomplished in Cana of Galilee, and it manifested his glory, and his disciples believed in him.
decades.meditation: At the compassionate intercession of His Mother, Christ changes water into the choicest wine, awakening faith in the hearts of His disciples.

artwork.title: The Marriage at Cana
artwork.current_location: Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art, Kansas City, Missouri

decades.title: The Proclamation of the Kingdom of God
decades.scripture_text: Jesus went into Galilee, preaching the Gospel of the kingdom of God, and saying: "For the time has been fulfilled and the kingdom of God has drawn near. Repent and believe in the Gospel."... Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven... Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
decades.meditation: Upon the Galilean hillside, Christ proclaims the Beatitudes, calling every soul to conversion of heart, merciful forgiveness, and childlike trust in the Father.

artwork.title: The Sermon on the Mount
artwork.current_location: Museum of National History, Frederiksborg Castle, Hillerød, Denmark

decades.title: The Transfiguration
decades.scripture_text: And while he was praying, the appearance of his countenance was altered, and his vestment became white and shining. And behold, two men were talking with him. And these were Moses and Elijah, appearing in majesty... And a voice came from the cloud, saying: "This is my beloved Son. Listen to him."
decades.meditation: Upon the holy mountain, the divine glory of God shines forth from the face of Christ, strengthening His Apostles for the coming Passion and revealing our call to transfiguring grace.

artwork.title: The Transfiguration of Christ
artwork.current_location: Church of Our Lady (Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekerk), Bruges, Belgium

decades.title: The Institution of the Eucharist
decades.scripture_text: Now while they were eating the meal, Jesus took bread, and he blessed and broke and gave it to his disciples, and he said: "Take and eat. This is my body." And taking the chalice, he gave thanks. And he gave it to them, saying: "Drink from this, all of you. For this is my blood of the new covenant, which shall be shed for many as a remission of sins."
decades.meditation: Having loved His own unto the end, Christ offers His Body, Blood, Soul, and Divinity, under the appearances of bread and wine, to remain truly, really, and substantially present with His Church forever.

mystery_sets.title: The Sorrowful Mysteries
mystery_sets.liturgical_note: Traditionally prayed on Tuesdays, Fridays, and Sundays of Lent.
mystery_sets.theme_summary: Entering into the saving Passion and Death of Our Lord Jesus Christ, by which the world is redeemed.

decades.title: The Agony in the Garden
decades.scripture_text: And he was separated from them by about a stone's throw. And kneeling down, he prayed, saying: "Father, if you are willing, take this chalice away from me. Yet truly, let not my will, but yours, be done." Then an Angel appeared to him from heaven, strengthening him. And being in agony, he prayed more intensely; and so his sweat became like drops of blood, running down to the ground.
decades.meditation: In the dark stillness of Gethsemane, Christ bears the weight of every human sin, uniting His sacred heart to the Father's redemptive will.

artwork.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives (Christ's Fear of Death)

decades.title: The Scourging at the Pillar
decades.scripture_text: Therefore, Pilate then took Jesus into custody and scourged him... But he himself was wounded because of our iniquities. He was bruised because of our wickedness. The discipline of our peace was upon him. And by his wounds, we are healed.
decades.meditation: Bound to the pillar in silence, the innocent Lamb of God endures cruel blows in reparation for our sins and to heal our wounded human nature.

decades.title: The Crowning with Thorns
decades.scripture_text: And stripping him, they put a scarlet cloak around him. And plaiting a crown of thorns, they placed it on his head, with a reed in his right hand. And genuflecting before him, they mocked him, saying, "Hail, King of the Jews." And spitting on him, they took the reed and struck his head.
decades.meditation: Crowned with sharp thorns and mocked by soldiers, the true King of Kings teaches us meekness and courage when enduring the world's contempt.

artwork.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns (La coronación de espinas)

decades.title: The Carrying of the Cross
decades.scripture_text: And carrying his own cross, he went forth to the place which is called Calvary... And as they were leading him away, they apprehended a certain one, Simon of Cyrene, as he was returning from the countryside. And they imposed the cross on him to carry after Jesus. Then a great crowd of people followed him, with women who were mourning and lamenting him.
decades.meditation: Falling beneath the heavy wood along the way to Calvary, Christ exchanges a look of piercing love with His grieving Mother, inviting us to take up our daily cross after Him.

artwork.title: Christ Falling on the Way to Calvary (Lo Spasimo di Sicilia)
artwork.medium: Oil on panel transferred to canvas

decades.title: The Crucifixion and Death of Our Lord
decades.scripture_text: And when they arrived at the place that is called Calvary, they crucified him there... Then Jesus said, "Father, forgive them. For they know not what they do."... And Jesus, crying out with a loud voice, said: "Father, into your hands I commend my spirit." And upon saying this, he expired.
decades.meditation: Raised upon the Cross of Calvary, Christ pardons His executioners, entrusts us to His Blessed Mother, and pours forth His last breath for the salvation of souls.

mystery_sets.title: The Glorious Mysteries
mystery_sets.liturgical_note: Traditionally prayed on Wednesdays, Sundays of Eastertide, and Sundays of Ordinary Time.
mystery_sets.theme_summary: Rejoicing in the triumph of the Risen Christ, the outpouring of the Holy Spirit, and the heavenly glory of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

decades.title: The Resurrection of Our Lord
decades.scripture_text: And upon entering the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, covered with a white robe, and they were astonished. And he said to them, "Do not become frightened. You are seeking Jesus of Nazareth, the Crucified One. He has risen. He is not here. Behold, the place where they laid him."
decades.meditation: At dawn on the third day, Christ bursts the bonds of death and rises in radiant majesty, opening the gates of eternal life to all who believe in Him.

artwork.title: The Resurrection of the Lord (La Resurrección del Señor)
artwork.current_location: Real Academia de Bellas Artes de San Fernando, Madrid, Spain

decades.title: The Ascension of Our Lord into Heaven
decades.scripture_text: Then he led them out as far as Bethania. And lifting up his hands, he blessed them. And it happened that, while he was blessing them, he withdrew from them, and he was carried up into heaven. And worshiping, they returned to Jerusalem with great joy... And when he had said these things, while they were watching, he was lifted up, and a cloud took him from their sight.
decades.meditation: Forty days after His Resurrection, Christ ascends from the Mount of Olives to the right hand of the Father, preparing a place for us in our heavenly homeland.

artwork.title: The Ascension
artwork.current_location: Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, Massachusetts

decades.title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
decades.scripture_text: All these were persevering with one accord in prayer with the women, and with Mary, the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers... And when the days of Pentecost were completed, they were all together in the same place. And suddenly, there came a sound from heaven, like that of a wind approaching violently, and it filled the entire house where they were sitting. And there appeared to them separate tongues, as if of fire, which settled upon each one of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit.
decades.meditation: Gathered in prayer around the Virgin Mary in the Upper Room, the Apostles receive the fire of the Holy Spirit and go forth boldly to preach the Gospel to all nations.

decades.title: The Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary
decades.scripture_text: Rise up, O Lord, into your resting place. You and the ark of your sanctification... For behold, from this time, all generations shall call me blessed. For he who is great has done great things for me, and holy is his name... You are the glory of Jerusalem, you are the joy of Israel, you are the honor of our people.
decades.meditation: Having completed the course of her earthly life, the Immaculate Mother of God is taken up body and soul into heavenly glory by the power of her Divine Son.

artwork.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artwork.current_location: State Hermitage Museum, St. Petersburg, Russia

decades.title: The Coronation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
decades.scripture_text: And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon was under her feet, and on her head was a crown of twelve stars... I lived in the highest places, and my throne is in the pillar of a cloud.
decades.meditation: Exalted above all choirs of angels, the Blessed Virgin Mary is crowned Queen of Heaven and Earth by the Most Holy Trinity, reigning forever as our Mother and Advocate.

artwork.title: The Coronation of the Virgin (La coronación de la Virgen)
